summary: Verified all 4 master module search bars (Drivers, Vehicles, Customers, Suppliers/list) render, filter live, update count text, and clear buttons reset correctly. Tested both desktop (1920px) and mobile (375px) viewports. All searches functional; no crashes; mobile layout does not overlap header buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: Suppliers/list uses in-memory .filter() on possibly large dataset (14k+ rows rendered in DOM in test env) — consider virtualization or pagination for perf. Not blocking for this iter.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 master search bars verified working. Suppliers/list must be navigated to via /suppliers/list URL (nested route inside Suppliers component). Demo login via localStorage + POST /api/auth/demo-login combined works reliably.
